Package com.elotouch.elopay.library

Class EloPeripheralManager.PoE

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.elotouch.elopay.library.EloPeripheralManager.PoE
  • Enclosing class:
    EloPeripheralManager
    public class EloPeripheralManager.PoE
extends java.lang.Object
    The PoE class to control PoE power and check whether the power source is PoE. These models support PoE feature:

    "i4_in10_std" (i-series 4.0)

    "i4_in15_std" (i-series 4.0)

    "i4_in22_std" (i-series 4.0)

    • Method Detail

      • isPoeOn

        public boolean isPoeOn()
        Whether the power source is PoE now.
        Returns:
        true if power source is PoE, and false if power source is AC adapter.

      • isPoeSystemReady

        public boolean isPoeSystemReady()
        For POE LLDP: Whether POE state is ready or not, it will check: 1. The granted power level via Ethernet protocols (POE LLDP) from router. 2. system has been switched into POE mode after handling EloPeripheralManager.ACTION_POE_CHANGED

        Note: if power source is AC now, return true.

      • getPoeLinkPower

        public float getPoeLinkPower()
        For POE LLDP: Get the power level that granted from router via Ethernet protocols (POE LLDP).

        Note: If router has not LLDP capable, return POE module's power capacity.

      • isFeatureEnabled

        public boolean isFeatureEnabled​(int feature)
        Check whether the feature is allowed or not when PoE is on.
        Parameters:
        feature - is the PoE feature POE_FEATURE_xx, define in EloPeripheralManager.PoE
        Returns:
        true means this feature is allowed when PoE is on, false means this feature is not allowed when PoE is on.

      • enableFeature

        public boolean enableFeature​(int feature,
                             boolean enable)
        User allows/forbids feature for PoE power consumption.
        Parameters:
        enable - true means allow this feature when PoE is on, else false
        feature - is the PoE feature POE_FEATURE_xx and define in EloPeripheralManager.PoE
        Returns:
        Returns true if feature type valid and PoE power don't overflow, else false.

        Note: if user disable feature in PoE power Manager while PoE is on, system will turn off this feature automatically, e.g. turn off WiFi or USB port.

      • getBrightnessForPoe

        public int getBrightnessForPoe()
        Get the screen brightness restricted level for PoE power consumption, which is set in PoE power manager.

      • setBrightnessForPoe

        public boolean setBrightnessForPoe​(int level)
        Set the screen brightness restricted level for PoE power consumption.
        Parameters:
        level - new screen brightness value that user wants to set
        Returns:
        Returns true if new screen brightness valid and PoE power don't overflow, else false.

      • getVolumeRatioForPoe

        public int getVolumeRatioForPoe()
        Get the media volume restricted ratio for PoE power consumption, which is set in PoE power manager.

        Note: the music volume for PoE = ratio * AudioManager.getStreamMaxVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC)

      • getStreamVolumeForPoe

        public int getStreamVolumeForPoe​(int streamType)
        Get the stream restricted volume for PoE power consumption, which is set in PoE power manager.
        Parameters:
        streamType - The stream type whose volume index is returned.

        Note: the steam volume for PoE = poe_volume_ratio * AudioManager.getStreamMaxVolume(streamType) / 100

      • setVolumeRatioForPoe

        public boolean setVolumeRatioForPoe​(int ratio)
        Set the media volume restricted ratio for PoE power consumption.
        Parameters:
        ratio - new music volume ratio that user wants to set
        Returns:
        Returns true if new media volume ratio valid and PoE power don't overflow, else false.

        Note: the music volume for PoE = ratio * AudioManager.getStreamMaxVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC)

      • getPowerForFeature

        public float getPowerForFeature​(int feature)
        Get the power consumption for the feature.
        Parameters:
        feature - is the PoE feature POE_FEATURE_xx, define in EloPeripheralManager.PoE
        Returns:
        the power consumption for this feature.

      • restorePoeSettings

        public void restorePoeSettings​(@NonNull
                               android.os.Bundle customData)
        Restore POE settings with custom data, and customer can use this API to apply OEM POE configuration and OEM POE power consumption data.
        Parameters:
        customData - The bundle is used to custom OEM POE settings and OEM POE power consumption data, which is create by com.elotouch.elopay.library.poe.PoeCustomBundle, if the customData is null, reset POE settings to default

      • getUserMaxPower

        public float getUserMaxPower()
        Get the total power capacity for user changeable power in PoE power manager which supplies to non-platform feature. it is used to calculate free power in PoE power manager when handle PoE dynamic UI.

      • getUserAvailablePower

        public float getUserAvailablePower()
        Get the available power capacity for user changeable power in PoE power manager which supplies to non-platform feature, which equals userMaxPowr - totalAllowedFeaturePower.

      • getMaxPowerCapacity

        public float getMaxPowerCapacity()
        Get the PoE power capacity which is defined by PoE module.
